Question: i want to go uk for both studies and as wel as for work also but i am facing lot of diffculties like visa process and fees for admission so pls give me some duas which help me to get my destations smoothly. Answer ID: 19358 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 206/180/D=1431) Perform two rak?ah with the intention of Salat al-Hajah and engage yourself in dua, the motto will be achieved with ease. It is written in Bahishti Zewar (v 9, p 86) that one should recite this dua for twelve days 12000 times followed by dua, in-shaAllah every kind of concern will vanish: اللھم یا بدیع العجائب بالخیر یا بدیع Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
